summary.headline: Planetary Reception and Aspects
summary.text: Astrological doctrine of planetary reception and perfection of matters: the Sun and Mars are compared by house and exaltation, while mutual reception between the Sun and Saturn varies by conjunction, opposition, trine, and sextile. Fortunate planets ameliorate good and evil planets, but oppositions bring labor, error, enmity, and contrariety.
